name: Linus
title: Early Christian in Rome
summary: Linus was a Christian in Rome mentioned by Paul in his second letter to Timothy. He sends greetings to Timothy along with other believers in the church at Rome. According to early church tradition, he later became the second bishop of Rome after the apostle Peter.

keyEvents.title: Greeting to Timothy
keyEvents.description: Linus is mentioned alongside other Christians in Rome who send their greetings to Timothy through Paul's letter. This shows that he was an active part of the early Christian community in Rome.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Church in Rome
keyEvents.description: Linus was one of the believers who stood with Paul during the apostle's final days in Rome, testifying to his faithfulness and commitment to the gospel.
